import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots for comprehensive insights
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Top Products by Revenue
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(8)
bars1 = ax1.barh(product_revenue.index, product_revenue.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Top Products by Revenue', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
for i, v in enumerate(product_revenue.values):
    ax1.text(v, i, f' ${v:.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales by Customer Age Group
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales_ordered = age_sales.reindex([x for x in age_order if x in age_sales.index])
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(age_sales_ordered.values, labels=age_sales_ordered.index, 
                                      autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, 
                                      colors=sns.color_palette("Set2", len(age_sales_ordered)))
ax2.set_title('Revenue Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
    autotext.set_fontsize(10)

# 3. Payment Method Preferences
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
payment_counts = df.groupby('payment_method').size().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars3 = ax3.barh(payment_counts.index, payment_counts.values, 
                 color=sns.color_palette("coolwarm", len(payment_counts)))
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Payment Method', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Payment Method Usage', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
for i, v in enumerate(payment_counts.values):
    ax3.text(v, i, f' {v}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 4. Takeaway vs Dine-in Revenue by Size
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df['order_type'] = df['is_takeaway'].map({1: 'Takeaway', 0: 'Dine-in'})
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_takeaway = df.groupby(['size', 'order_type'])['total'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
size_takeaway = size_takeaway.reindex([s for s in size_order if s in size_takeaway.index])

x = np.arange(len(size_takeaway.index))
width = 0.35
if 'Dine-in' in size_takeaway.columns:
    bars_dinein = ax4.bar(x - width/2, size_takeaway['Dine-in'], width, 
                          label='Dine-in', color='#3498db', alpha=0.8)
if 'Takeaway' in size_takeaway.columns:
    bars_takeaway = ax4.bar(x + width/2, size_takeaway['Takeaway'], width, 
                            label='Takeaway', color='#e74c3c', alpha=0.8)

ax4.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Revenue by Size and Order Type', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.set_xticks(x)
ax4.set_xticklabels(size_takeaway.index)
ax4.legend(fontsize=10, framealpha=0.9)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
